test_title: PYST 26: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On: 23 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Aesthetic value is specifically a way in which we __can get positive conclude value__ from the world at large.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The underlined segment "positive conclude value" is incorrect because "conclude" is a verb and does not fit in this context. The noun form "conclusive" is needed to describe the type of value correctly.

Therefore, the corrected sentence should be "Aesthetic value is specifically a way in which we can get positive conclusive value from the world at large."

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Aesthetic value is specifically a way in which we can get positive conclusive value from the world at large."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 1: "can get positive convalescent value"** – "Convalescent" relates to recovery and is not appropriate in this context.
 
• **Option 2: "can get positive convulsive value"** – "Convulsive" relates to convulsions and is not relevant here.
 
• **Option 4: "can get positive contrastive value"** – "Contrastive" implies a contrast and does not fit the intention of the sentence.
